‘PANAHON NA NG PAGBABAGO’

Miss Earth Philippines 2025 Joy Barcoma attends the Kilusang Bayan Kontra Kurakot press briefing for the upcoming November 30 ‘Protestang Bayan Kontra Kurakot’ anti-corruption protest in Luneta, Manila. 

She encourages the public to participate in the rally and call for genuine systemic change.

IN PHOTOS │Local members of PAMALAKAYA in Navotas held a fluvial protest on Wednesday calling for the resignation of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and Vice President Sara Duterte amid what they describe as systemic corruption in flood-control projects and the “relentless plunder of coastal communities and fishing grounds,” which they say has further endangered fishing communities during natural calamities.

The group is demanding full accountability from government officials involved in the plunder of public funds and exploitation of natural resources, saying these actions have “severely worsened” the vulnerability of coastal communities to flooding and other disasters. │Rex Espiritu

📸: Pamalakaya 

👉 For the latest news, visit https://t.co/rmQCnNSOvI
